transforms: Searched Wikimedia Commons only (Wikidata P18, Commons categories, English and Arabic Commons search, and depicts statements) for the 57 canonical universities.
Kept free-licence candidates only (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA) and reviewed licence, creator, and file page metadata through the Commons API.
Rejected candidates that were too small, showed interiors or people, depicted a different institution, or had a licence that could not be verified.
Resized each approved photo to WebP and AVIF variants at 640, 1280, and 1920 px wide without upscaling; smaller originals keep their own width as the largest variant. No crops or other edits.
Uploaded the 54 variants to R2 under the universities/<university-id>/cover-v1 key namespace and verified every CDN URL returns HTTP 200 with a matching SHA-256.
Added cover asset records with Commons file page, creator, licence, and attribution requirements to data/assets.json, and one approved source per file to data/sources.json.
reviewNotes: Optional cover photo batch: 10 approved Wikimedia Commons photos for 10 of 57 canonical universities. Damascus University uses a Faculty of Medicine building photo; the Syrian Private University photo shows its hospital building. Cover photos do not change the logo coverage gate.
